fix.notes: The selector `.game pre` is scoped exclusively to the game log partial; it will not affect any other `<pre>` elements on the site. `white-space: pre-wrap` is preferred over `overflow-x: auto` here because it avoids a secondary scrollbar within the page and keeps the log fully visible without requiring the user to scroll right.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The game log view at `/match/<id>/` renders the PDBot game log inside a `<pre>` element. Because `<pre>` preserves whitespace and does not wrap by default, long lines caused a horizontal scrollbar across the page.

## What changed

- `logsite/templates/game_view.mustache`: Added `class="game"` to the `<section>` element so the log container has a targetable CSS class.
- `shared_web/static/css/pd.css`: Added `.game pre { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: break-word; }` at the end of the file. This preserves newlines and indentation (important for log readability) while wrapping long lines instead of extending the page horizontally.

## Validation

`uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` passed. The fix is pure CSS/template with no Python logic, so no unit tests cover it directly; visual inspection of the template change confirms the selector is correctly scoped to game log sections only.

Fixes #11566
